summary: Narrow winding road through bush with no room to stop clear of the lane.
reasons: No verge or pull-off beside the lane
No cars parked along this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the north side and a wooded bank to the south; houses 16 to 25 m up the slope.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed lane of one carriageway with trees and a bank at the edge; no gravel or grass shoulder wide enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Through road linking Carmody Road to the avenue; narrow bend.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time signs beside the line; no parked cars until the corner at the end.

flags: Dwellings 11 m at the far end
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over most of the section from both sides.
